text: the deployment pipeline runs on kubernetes with argo rollouts
database migrations are applied by atlas during deployment
the staging deployment cluster is shared between all teams
incident retrospectives happen every thursday afternoon
the oncall rotation is two weeks per engineer
lunch is catered on fridays in the office kitchen
parking permits are renewed through the facilities portal
the coffee machine on floor two takes whole beans only
release tags are signed with the team gpg key before publishing
the deployment freeze window runs from december 20th to january 2nd
